snippet.title: Join the resistance in Pikuniku 2! | Reveal Trailer | Coming 2027
snippet.description:
Nintendo Switch 2 and Steam: http://pikuniku2.com for more!
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676350/Pikuniku_2/

Absurd puzzle-exploration adventure Pikuniku 2 brings the whimsy! Wander, solve, and gossip your way through a weird and wonderful world where not everything is as happy as it seems. Protect the potato!

Get your kicks in Pikuniku 2, coming 2027.
